$comment: Reference schema + the compiled-in default for the OS app sandbox (Island).
The OS uses these exact values when no /data/system/lobium/sandbox-policy.json is present.
Per machine, the host stages a file with the same shape (from the create form / IslandConfig);
the running OS re-reads it via `adb shell cmd lobium_sandbox reload`.
The capability is never disable-able — this file only shapes it.

$fields.mode: 'all' = sandbox every third-party app on install (default). 'selected' = only sandboxedApps.
$fields.sandboxedApps: package names always sandboxed when mode == 'selected'; ignored when 'all'.
$fields.isolation: 'per-app' = one isolated profile per app (strongest). 'shared' = one sandbox profile.
$fields.freezeIdleApps: force-stop sandboxed apps when idle so they can't run/track in the background.
